ArchitectureNotes.objective: Identity management microservice in MIF: Reader (query-only user/role cache), Writer (command gateway), Worker (saga processor + Keycloak sync via MQ).
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: No custom auth server, no LDAP/AD integration, no web UI admin console.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Keycloak availability: admin API down triggers Worker saga failure and compensation.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: Cache invalidation: drift between Keycloak and MongoDB on concurrent updates.

contract.purpose: User, role, event DTOs shared across Reader, Writer, Worker.
Query-only API: user/role cache from MongoDB, token introspection (no saga involvement).

fn-QueryCacheOrKeycloak.PURPOSE: Query cache first, fall back to Keycloak on miss

contract.purpose: Command gateway: user provisioning and role sync commands routed to MQ async (202 Accepted).
Saga processor: ProvisionUserSaga (Keycloak → MongoDB), SyncRoleSaga (bidirectional Keycloak ↔ MongoDB) with compensation.

class-ProvisionUserSaga.PURPOSE: Keycloak create → MongoDB cache → emit UserProvisioned

class-SyncRoleSaga.PURPOSE: Keycloak role assign → MongoDB cache invalidate → emit RoleSynced (PENDING)

contract.purpose: Keycloak admin API client + JWT validator with JWKS cache.

export-ITokenValidator.PURPOSE: Token validation: JWKS cache + JWT parsing

contract.purpose: MongoDB user/role cache: fast queries without Keycloak calls, TTL-based invalidation.

DF-USER-PROVISION.NAME: User Provisioning
DF-USER-PROVISION.step-1: Writer receives UserCreatedDto, validates, publishes to MQ.
DF-USER-PROVISION.step-2: Worker ProvisionUserSaga: create in Keycloak, cache in MongoDB, emit UserProvisioned.
DF-USER-PROVISION.step-3: On Keycloak failure, compensate: revert MongoDB cache.

DF-QUERY-USER.NAME: User Query (Cache)
DF-QUERY-USER.step-2: Cache miss: validate token against Keycloak JWKS (in-memory cache), update MongoDB cache.

DF-SAGA-SYNC.NAME: Role Sync Saga
DF-SAGA-SYNC.step-1: Writer publishes role assign command to MQ.
DF-SAGA-SYNC.step-2: Worker SyncRoleSaga: assign in Keycloak, update MongoDB cache, invalidate user cache.
DF-SAGA-SYNC.step-3: On failure, compensate: revert Keycloak and MongoDB.

Phase-1.name: Foundation
Phase-1.goal: Establish solution structure, shared contracts, persistence layer, Keycloak adapter, and unit test harness.

solution.name: IdentityServices
solution.step-1: Create IdentityServices.sln + IdentityService.Shared project with all DTOs/events/commands.
solution.step-2: Implement IdentityService.CacheLayer: MongoDB user/role cache, TTL indexes, repositories.
solution.step-3: Implement IdentityService.KeycloakAdapter: Keycloak admin API client, JWT parser, JWKS cache (in-memory).
solution.step-4: Integration tests: Testcontainers.MongoDB, JWKS cache refresh, TTL invalidation.

Phase-2.name: Reader-and-Writer
Phase-2.goal: Query path (Reader + token introspection) and command gateway (Writer) working end-to-end up to MQ publish.

solution.name: IdentityServices
solution.step-1: Implement IdentityService.Api.ReaderService: GET /api/users/{id}, POST /api/introspect, cache queries (no Keycloak fallback).
solution.step-2: Implement IdentityService.Api.WriterService: POST /api/users (create), POST /api/users/{id}/roles (assign), Dapr pub/sub publish with partition key (userId).
solution.step-3: Integration test: Reader queries cache only, token introspection validates JWKS, Writer→MQ publish verified.

Phase-3.name: Worker-Saga
Phase-3.goal: Saga processing: ProvisionUserSaga (Keycloak→MongoDB) with DLQ failure handling. SyncRoleSaga (bidirectional) pending.

solution.name: IdentityServices
solution.step-1: Implement IdentityService.WorkerService: ProvisionUserSaga (Keycloak create→cache), idempotency checks.
solution.step-2: DLQ handler: on saga failure at any step, publish FailedIdentityEvent to DLQ with full context (original input, failed step, error, Keycloak response).
solution.step-3: Saga integration tests: happy path, DLQ on Keycloak API failure, idempotency replay, concurrent saga per userId isolation.
solution.step-4: Implement SyncRoleSaga: bidirectional Keycloak role assign ↔ MongoDB cache invalidate with DLQ compensation.

Phase-4.name: Deployment-and-Scale
Phase-4.goal: K8s manifests, Dapr component configs, GitOps pipeline, and throughput validation under load.

solution.name: IdentityServices
solution.step-1: K8s manifests: Reader/Writer/Worker Deployments, Dapr pub/sub Component, MongoDB StatefulSet, DLQ topic, Keycloak sidecar config.
solution.step-2: GitOps pipeline: centralized repo integration, automated deploy on merge to main.
solution.step-3: Load test: 500 op/s sustained on write path, cache hit rate ≥95%, verify partition distribution by userId, measure p99 latency, validate DLQ processing under Keycloak degradation.

ExecutionPolicy.worker-owns: Only module source and tests in approved write scope
ExecutionPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, unclear Keycloak API version
